stores.note: Self Edge runs on OpenCart, not Shopify. Stock was checked from the per-size counts on each product page (e.g. '4+ left in stock'). The page-level 'In Stock' label shows even when every size is sold out, so it can't be trusted. Product URLs use the site's index.php?route=product/product&product_id= form.
stores.vibe: A cult Japanese-repro and heavy-denim specialist (Iron Heart, Flat Head, Studio D'Artisan, Boncoura, Samurai) with lots of store exclusives, where the fabric is the point: slub, nep, loopwheel, horsehide.
